title: EncodeVideoPayload
description: Request to encode an uploaded video into adaptive-bitrate DASH and HLS output. Sent by the API and processed by the video encoding worker.

videoId.description: Identifier of the video being encoded, used to correlate the outcome

source.description: Blob containing the uploaded original video

destination.description: Container and blob-name prefix that receives the manifests and segments

prefix.description: Blob-name prefix for the output, for example 'video-123/'. Empty writes to the container root.

containerName.description: Azure Blob container name: 3-63 lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens
